title: 경찰착용기록장치 운영 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Retention Period for Video and Audio Records)
(1) The retention period for video and audio records made using police body-worn recording devices shall be 30 days from the date on which such records are transmitted to and stored in a video and audio record information database under Article 10-6 (3) of the Act; provided, the period shall be 90 days where the records relate to a crime under investigation or fall under other circumstances prescribed by the Commissioner General of the Korean National Police Agency or the Commissioner General of the Korea Coast Guard.
(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the Commissioner General of the Korean National Police Agency, the Commissioner General of the Korea Coast Guard, the commissioner of a metropolitan or provincial police agency, the commissioner of a regional coast guard agency, the head of the Central Maritime Special Rescue Unit, the chief of a police station, or the chief of a coast guard station may extend the retention period once only, by up to 90 days, where continued retention of video and audio records is deemed necessary, including where evidence must be preserved for a criminal investigation.
